name: Swallowtail butterflies
desc: Forest butterflies such as the flying handkerchief swallowtail. They feed on flowers like lantana.
about: Papilio dardanus, the Saharan swallowtail, African swallowtail, mocker swallowtail or flying handkerchief, is a species of butterfly in the family Papilionidae (the swallowtails).
